rewrites.pattern:
```
node "\$\{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\}/scripts/dashboard\.mjs"
```

If the path above still shows `\$\{CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\}`, the script is `scripts/dashboard\.mjs` in this plugin's folder
\(`[^`]+`, under `~/\.claude/plugins/`\): find it with Glob and run it the same way\.
rewrites.replacement:
```
node "<plugin folder>/scripts/dashboard.mjs"
```

The plugin folder (`{plugin}`) is three folders above this skill's `SKILL.md` (`ports/skills/dashboard/`).
